references.text: The first census of the tribe of Ephraim, which provided the basis for the number mentioned here in the camp of Ephraim.
The preceding verses describe the three tribes that made up the camp of Ephraim: Ephraim, Manasseh, and Benjamin, along with their respective numbers.
Describes when the camp of Ephraim broke camp and set out as the third group, in accordance with the order given here.
Jacob's blessing over Ephraim, where he predicts that Ephraim will become greater than Manasseh and become the ancestor of many nations.
Moses' blessing over Joseph (Ephraim and Manasseh), describing their strength and multitude.
